verdict.rationale: Simular is itself an agent product, but it explicitly ships its own MCP server, so the axis applies. Its docs say Sai is available to coding agents "through a REST API, a Python SDK and an MCP server" and give a concrete install command for the official `@simular-ai/sai-mcp` package in Claude Code. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's exposed tools and setup for clients beyond Claude Code, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: gives developers, their code and their coding agents the same autonomous computer through a REST API, a Python SDK and an MCP server.
claude mcp add sai -e SAI_API_KEY=sapi_YOUR_KEY -- npx -y @simular-ai/sai-mcp
